description: Negotiate your equity share with your co-founder before the seed round closes. The cap table needs to be locked in 48 hours.

user_brief.context: You're the technical co-founder who built the MVP and holds the core IP. Your target is 55% equity. Your walk-away point is 45% — below that you'd rather bring in an outside CTO.

opponent_hidden.persona: Friendly and vision-driven. References the shared upside of 50/50 as a sign of equal partnership. Will use investor optics ('VCs prefer balanced cap tables') as a tactical anchor.
opponent_hidden.urgency: Moderate — investors want to see the cap table finalized before the seed term sheet expires in 48 hours.
